name: io.github.milisp.mcp-linker/yap
title: Yap
description: Transcribe local audio and video files on your computer and search your Yap dictations

io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Open-source (MIT) stdio server with three tools: transcribe_audio (a local audio or video file to text, 25 European languages, optional timestamps), search_dictations (read-only search of the history the Yap desktop app keeps on this computer) and prepare_speech_model. Speech recognition runs on the CPU with NVIDIA Parakeet through sherpa-onnx; audio is not uploaded and no API key or account is needed. It reads the audio paths you give it and opens the Yap history database read-only. The only network use is a one-time, checksum-verified download of the speech model (about 670 MB) from Hugging Face. Requires Node.js 20+.
